summary: The agent failed pytest despite custom verification passing, confirming the existing skill's warning about relying on custom checks over the actual test suite. The trace shows the agent ran pytest only at the end after building the entire workbook, missing incremental validation opportunities. The Y/Y Growth formula also initially referenced wrong cells (label column instead of year totals). This update strengthens the existing excel-financial-modeling skill by moving pytest earlier in the workflow, adding explicit summary dashboard cross-sheet validation steps, and reinforcing the decision rule that pytest failures trump custom verification passes.
